Board draft, not for circulation. Revision of the allergen policy after the
March incident, when a sesame-topped roll went out on the nut-free tray. Muffet
spotted it at the stall and pulled the tray; no customer reaction reported.
Proposed changes: a second-person check of every tray card, and the blue bowl
rule written into the induction. To be agreed before the shared policy changes.
